detail: Owner-occupied: Police Credit Union Ltd 6.19% vs Northern Inland Credit Union Limited 6.39%. Investment: Northern Inland Credit Union Limited 6.39% vs Police Credit Union Ltd 6.39%. At 80% LVR.

headline: 3-year fixed P&I: Police Credit Union Ltd is better if you'll live in the property; Easy Street is better for investors
detail: Owner-occupied: Police Credit Union Ltd 6.19% vs Easy Street 6.24%. Investment: Easy Street 6.24% vs Police Credit Union Ltd 6.39%. At 80% LVR.

headline: Police Credit Union Ltd is cheapest on 5-year fixed P&I for both owner-occupiers and investors
detail: 6.39% owner-occupied and 6.59% for investors at 80% LVR — an investor premium of 0.20 pp.

headline: Investor premium ranges from 0.00 pp (Westpac) to 1.50 pp (Central Murray Bank)
detail: Gap between each lender's best variable P&I investor and owner-occupier rate, 86 lenders. Median premium 0.20 pp. If you're an investor, Westpac penalises you least.

headline: Typical 1-year fixed rate is 0.08 pp above typical variable
detail: Owner-occupied P&I medians across lenders: variable 6.51%; 1-year fixed 6.59%, 2-year fixed 6.64%, 3-year fixed 6.69%, 5-year fixed 6.84%.

headline: Credit Union SA rewards a bigger deposit the most: 0.95 pp cheaper at 60% LVR than 85%
detail: 6.54% at 60% LVR vs 7.49% at 85% (owner-occupied variable P&I). Best at 60% LVR overall: Westpac 4.99%.

headline: An offset account costs at least 1.15 pp extra in rate
detail: Cheapest variable owner-occupied P&I with offset: Fire Service Credit Union 6.14% (L25 Firefighter Package). Cheapest overall: Westpac 4.99%. Weigh the rate gap against your expected offset balance.

headline: Highest term-deposit rate: Suncorp Bank, 1-year at 5.75%
detail: Median 3-month 4.45% vs 5-year 4.00% — shorter terms currently pay more than longer ones. Based on a $10,000 deposit.

headline: Bonus conditions are worth up to 1.60 pp over the best no-strings savings rate
detail: Maitland Mutual Limited pays up to 4.95% (4.50% base + 0.45% bonus: Bonus interest is payable if there are no withdrawals for the month.). Without conditions, Northern Inland Credit Union Limited pays 3.35%.

headline: Lowest card rate isn't fee-free: Bankwest 18.99% vs Bank Australia 12.34% with no annual fee
detail: Bankwest Zero Platinum Mastercard carries about $15 a year in fees. On a balance of $150,000 the two cost about the same per year.

headline: 110 of 115 brands have data-quality issues in their published product data
detail: Most errors: Bank of China (145), Credit Union SA (124), Gateway Bank (111). See the Data quality report; affected rates may be missing from comparisons.
